subject: Urgent: Antara Conference rooming list updates for Apr 16
body:
Dear Groups Desk,

We realize the April 13 change deadline has passed. Could you please confirm which of these updates you can still accommodate for Antara Conference at Harvard?

• Ana Lucía Quispe Mamani: move Apr 15–17 to check-in Apr 16, checkout Apr 18 (nights Apr 16 and 17). Her replacement flight lands at 3:40 PM Friday, and she is going straight to the conference. Please hold the room for a later Friday arrival; exact hotel ETA is not yet known. No early check-in needed.
• Ricardo Paredes Leiva: he is missing from your list. Please add check-in Apr 16, checkout Apr 18 (nights Apr 16 and 17). His flight lands at 6:50 AM Friday; hotel ETA is unconfirmed. We understand the 48-hour early check-in notice window has passed. If he reaches you before 3 PM, could you advise if an early room is still possible, or if luggage storage is available until regular check-in?
• Javier Huamán Torres: move check-in from Apr 15 to Apr 16 and retain Apr 17 checkout (one night). His new flight lands at 2:10 PM Friday; no early check-in requested because his hotel arrival time is not known.

Elena Castañeda Ruiz, Valeria Montenegro Ugarte and Camila Ferreyra Soto remain Apr 15–17; Isabel Navarro Prado remains Apr 16–18. Please confirm the revised list and flag anything you cannot accommodate.

Thank you,
Antara Conference Team
send_blocked_reasons: Only reminders and policy answers may be sent.
Recipient is not the original approved speaker address.
